selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What central truth is introduced in this passage?
questions.answer: It introduces the truth that Allah compassionately provides for His creatures and gives them what they need.

questions.question: What kinds of provision are mentioned for living beings?
questions.answer: Both physical needs and non-physical needs are mentioned.

questions.question: Which groups among living creatures receive special focus, and why is that important?
questions.answer: The weak, helpless, and young receive special focus, which highlights Allah’s mercy toward those least able to help themselves.

questions.question: According to the passage, how is provision given?
questions.answer: It is given at the right time, in an orderly way, and without neglect or disorder.

questions.question: What point is made by referring to the purest nourishment coming from between impure substances?
questions.answer: It shows Allah’s wisdom and power in bringing something beneficial and pure from an unlikely setting.

questions.question: What guarantee is described in the verse about every moving creature on earth?
questions.answer: The guarantee is that Allah takes responsibility for each creature’s provision.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention insects living at the bottom of the sea and their young?
questions.answer: It gives them as an example of creatures receiving provision in ways beyond ordinary human expectation.

questions.question: What example from the passage shows that even hidden creatures are not forgotten?
questions.answer: The example of sea-bottom insects and their offspring shows that even hidden creatures are provided for.

questions.question: What does the passage use to support its claim besides scriptural quotation?
questions.answer: It uses the many signs found throughout the universe.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage as a whole?
questions.answer: The main idea is that Allah alone, out of mercy and compassion, sustains all living creatures everywhere.

questions.question: What does the passage reveal about the range of creatures receiving provision?
questions.answer: It includes all animate beings, especially those with spirit, and especially the vulnerable among them.

questions.question: Why does the passage emphasize animate beings, especially those with spirit?
questions.answer: It emphasizes them because they clearly show the ongoing care and nurturing of Allah.

questions.question: What is the purpose of stating that provision comes through an unseen hand?
questions.answer: It points beyond visible means to Allah as the real source behind what creatures receive.

questions.question: What role does the verse about Allah being the Provider play in the passage?
questions.answer: It establishes the basic principle that Allah alone has the role of sustaining creation.

questions.question: What does the verse about every creature on earth contribute to that teaching?
questions.answer: It adds the ideas of Divine responsibility, knowledge, and recorded order.

questions.question: What does the verse about creatures that do not carry their provision emphasize?
questions.answer: It emphasizes that helpless creatures are still sustained by Allah even when they cannot provide for themselves.

questions.question: What human mistake is being warned against?
questions.answer: The warning is against treating worldly causes as if they were the real source of provision.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying many signs in the universe agree on this truth?
questions.answer: It means the created world itself gives matching evidence that one Provider sustains all life.

questions.question: What does “compassionateness and bestowal of provision” mean in this passage?
questions.answer: It means that Allah mercifully cares for living beings by giving them what they need to live.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah gives to living beings besides physical nourishment?
questions.answer: It says He gives both material and non-material forms of provision.

questions.question: What does the passage show by mentioning food coming from soil, wood, and even from within the body?
questions.answer: It shows that Allah brings provision from places that seem unlikely or lifeless, which points to His power and mercy.

questions.question: Why are dry, hard pieces of wood mentioned?
questions.answer: They show another surprising source from which Allah brings nourishment.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the Qur’an declare about the One who gives sustenance?
questions.answer: It declares that Allah alone is the giver of sustenance.

questions.question: What does the third Qur’anic verse say about creatures that cannot secure their own food?
questions.answer: It says that Allah provides for creatures that cannot carry or obtain their own sustenance.
